title: How to Survive Sleep Paralysis
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: How to survive sleep paralysis. Step one: don't fight.
first_visual: A woman rigid in bed, eyes wide, the warm highlight trembling; in the corner, a shape that isn't furniture.

beats.visual: Ivy rigid in bed, eyes wide; a shape in the corner.
beats.vo: How to survive sleep paralysis. Step one: don't fight.

beats.visual: Her eyes strain away from the corner.
beats.vo: Three: don't look at the corner.

beats.visual: The mattress dips at her feet; slow breaths not hers.
beats.vo: Four: if the bed dips, count its breaths. Not yours.

beats.visual: Clock dissolve: 3:10, 4:30, 5:50; blue dawn creeps in (grade).
Dawn. Ivy sits up, gasping, relieved, and scrolls the guide on her phone.
Guide footer: 'Thank you for lying so still. It makes it easier. - The Corner.'
beats.vo: Then I read who wrote it.

beats.visual: Key moment: mirror: Ivy's eyes are flat, with no warm highlight. In the corner behind her, two warm highlights blink.

ending: Her mirror eyes are flat. In the dark corner, two lamp-coloured highlights blink.

originality_review: Original. Survival steps authored by the threat; the signature reveal is ours. It serves sleep gap G4. It makes no medical claim: it is fiction, and the description should add a line that sleep paralysis is a real, usually harmless condition.
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: Ivy survives a night of sleep paralysis by following an online guide to the letter. At the bottom it is signed 'Thank you for lying so still. - The Corner.' In the mirror her eyes have lost their warm highlight. In the corner, two warm highlights blink.

hooks.line: How to survive sleep paralysis. Step one: don't fight.
hooks.first_visual: A woman rigid in bed, eyes wide, the warm highlight trembling; in the corner, a shape that isn't furniture.

hooks.line: Step three: whatever you do, don't look at the corner.
hooks.first_visual: Eyes straining sideways in the dark.

hooks.line: If the bed dips, count its breaths. Not yours.
hooks.first_visual: A mattress sinking at the foot of a bed.

hooks.line: I survived. Then I read who wrote the guide.
hooks.first_visual: A phone scrolled to the bottom of a page, a signature.

hooks.line: In the mirror, my eyes had lost their light.
hooks.first_visual: A woman's reflection with flat, dull eyes.

conflict: Ivy wants to survive the night without seeing what is there.
escalation: Don't fight; breathe slow; don't look; the bed dips; stay still until morning.
reveal: The guide was written by the thing. Stillness made it easy to take her light.
emotional_objective: Helplessness, then quiet theft. Uses the house style (lamp eye highlights) as the story beat.
